name: Axons Vision
summary: Axon Vision Ltd develops and markets artificial intelligence-based systems for the defence industry. The company's products focus on developing, identification and tracking capabilities on the modern battlefield. It offers aerial platforms designed to analyze visual information obtained from electro-optical payloads, and from video systems installed on manned and unmanned aerial platforms. The company's products include Edge360, an artificial intelligence-based decision making engine, Edge Remote Control Weapon Stations (EdgeRCWS), a fire control unit embedded with AI to automate the system's mechanical operation and automatic target recognition, EdgeSight, a tool for maximizing efficiency and survivability in the hands of the operator, and EdgeUAV, an artificial intelligence tool designed for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs, UAVs or drones and drones), which provides real-time identification and tracking capabilities. The company was formerly known as Axons Vision Ltd. and changed its name to Axon Vision Ltd in December 2025. Axon Vision Ltd was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
